final_message:
I have fixed the source code across the `bookings` package so that all functions conform to their specifications/docstrings and all tests pass successfully:

- **`bookings/timeutil.py`**: Updated `parse_duration` to correctly parse all supported duration formats (`"1h30m"`, `"2h"`, `"45m"`, `"1:30"`, and bare minutes).
- **`bookings/billing.py`**: Updated `billable_blocks` to always round up partial blocks using `math.ceil` and validate that `minutes >= 0` (raising `ValueError` for negative values).
- **`bookings/schedule.py`**: Fixed `add_slot` to use `None` as a default mutable argument and avoid shared state across separate calls.
- **`tests/test_bookings.py`**: Enhanced the existing test file with additional assertions covering all edge cases and formats specified in the docstrings (without modifying any existing tests that were part of the suite).
